King of Casino.name: King of Casino
King of Casino.summary: The chips are down as you and your buddies travel to Vegas in this high stakes adventure. Match wits (and luck!) against the house or up to four of your friends in a game with all the glitz and glamor of a real casino. Play Poker, Blackjack, slot machines, Keno or Roulette. Choose one of 15 different casinos. You're the odds-on favorite in this high-rolling gambling simulation.

Power League '93.name: Power League '93
Power League '93.summary: AKA: パワーリーグ'93. The most successful baseball game franchise on PC-Engine. The year 1993 version featured Hideo Nomo.
